name: Example kit
description: The worked example from Settings, Plugins, Make a plugin: a text look, a component, a skill and a shader effect in one data plugin. Nothing in it runs as a program. Start your own with pnpm plugin:new <id> --from uncut.example-kit.
author: Uncut

looks.name: Lower third
looks.description: A name line on a dark bar in the bottom left, sliding in.

components.name: Callout badge
components.description: A round badge with a short word and a ring that pulses, in the top left corner.
components.css: .badge{position:absolute;top:7%;left:5%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:14px 30px 14px 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#111;color:#fff;font:700 40px/1 -apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif;opacity:min(1, calc(var(--t) * 5))}.ring{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 0 calc(10px * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(var(--t) * 6))) color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 35%, transparent)}

skills.name: example-kit-lower-thirds
skills.title: Lower thirds
skills.description: Name and role captions for people on camera, with the Example kit's Lower third look.
skills.instructions:
Use this when someone speaks on camera and the viewer should know who they are.

- Put one lower third per person, the first time they appear, 0.5 s after their first word. Keep it on screen for 3 to 4 s.
- Text: their name, a comma, what they do, at most 6 words. Never invent a name or a role: ask with ask_user if the brief doesn't give them.
- Insert it with insert_text and the look uncut.example-kit.lower-third. Don't change its size or position unless it covers a face.
- If the speaker talks about something live (a launch, a stream), add the Callout badge component with the label Live.

shaders.name: Spotlight
shaders.description: A soft, tinted vignette that draws the eye to the middle and can breathe slowly.
